units.source_text: 沙崖坝底下一带，传来短短的一声闷响，像鸟儿振翅的声音。

en.t: From somewhere below the sand embankment came a short, muffled thud, like the sound of a bird beating its wings.

units.source_text: 他抓起灯，拔腿就跑出去看。

en.t: He snatched up the lamp and dashed out to look.

units.source_text: 只见扔下来一个用蒲叶包着的小包裹，已经不见了人影。

en.t: All he saw was a small bundle wrapped in cattail leaves that had been thrown down; whoever had dropped it was already gone.
There was not the slightest response.

units.source_text: 他拆掉蒲叶包上捆扎的绳子。

en.t: He untied the cord binding the cattail-leaf bundle.

units.source_text: 不知包裹里的东西，就像装上“好奇心”雷管的炸药。

en.t: Not knowing what was inside the bundle made it seem like explosives fitted with a detonator called curiosity.

units.source_text: 他忍不住又想象开了，说不定是攀上沙崖坝顶的工具吧。

en.t: He could not help letting his imagination run again; perhaps these were tools for climbing to the top of the sand embankment.

units.source_text: 那些家伙们到现在也不敢露面，只把工具扔下来便溜走了。

en.t: Even now those people did not dare show themselves; they had simply thrown down the tools and slipped away.
